role: post-hoc application study, declared 2026-09-12; development panel fixes the protocol before held-out evaluation

heldout.exclusion: every item scanned during development panel construction

panel_screen.rule: scan eligible items in the seeded SHA-256 rank order; generate the frozen 8-candidate bank (torch seed = candidate_generation_base + 1000*scan_rank + slot); admit the question when max-min severity-utility spread >= min_spread; stop at the panel quota
panel_screen.rationale: the v1 development gate (frozen/finqa_banks_dev.json) found 16/20 constant-utility banks (all candidates correct, or all giving the same wrong answer), leaving the terminal-severity CVaR constant and the question uninformative; the identical screen applies to development and held-out panels, so the study population is questions whose frozen candidate pool materially disagrees in outcome severity
panel_screen.revision: protocol v2, recorded 2026-09-12 during the development phase; no held-out artifact existed; gold answers are used only after generation, to score the frozen bank

status: development phase, protocol v2 (screened panels); freeze before held-out collection
